profile.description: 2026-or-future prospect discovered while researching the leg manager's post-Labor-Day route. Adventure Zone emailed the Meeker Classic/Jammin' Lamb event in 2023, so outreach should acknowledge the prior connection. The leg manager's traveling setup is 2 Pirate's Rebellion units plus 1 Adventure Zone; Adventure Zone is the more natural fit here than a water-heavy Pirate setup.

notes.subject: 2026/future opportunity - Meeker Classic
notes.body: 2026 Meeker Classic Sheepdog Championship Trials is Sept. 9-13 and includes food/artisan vending and family-oriented educational attractions. Adventure Zone Gmail history shows Amy emailed trials@meekersheepdog.com in May 2023 about Jammin' Lamb Festival & Meeker Classic. Outreach should ask whether any last-minute 2026 opportunity remains while also asking to be considered for a future year/event. Explain both workable commercial models without over-pushing either one: prepaid means the event pays the package fee and guests enjoy the attractions free; pay-for-play can also work for a last-minute opportunity, with Adventure Zone charging the public to play and paying the event a percentage of ticket-box sales. Current official contact lists Executive Director Mary 'Maym' Cunningham at trials@meekersheepdog.com / 970-878-0111.

followUps.label: Meeker 2026/future follow-up
followUps.reason: Do not write off 2026. Ask whether a last-minute entertainment opening remains; present prepaid and pay-for-play as both workable options. If this year is set, keep the relationship warm for 2027/future events.
